title: 1625 Prairie's entrance bay stands forward, as its photograph shows
items: The south part of McBirney's house at 1625 Prairie now stands a little forward of the rest, its corners edged in smooth quoin stones and capped by a hood moulding over the wide window.
The door has a smooth stone frame with a carved panel above it, and the lower windows sit in smooth stone surrounds.
A single band of stone now runs under the first-floor windows, as in the photograph, in place of two that were never there.
